div.head: EGu 1
div.ab: ⁊ þæt is þonon ærest, þæt hig gecwædon, þæt cyricgrið binnan wagum ⁊ cyninges handgrið stande efne unwemne.
⁊ þæt is þonon ærest, þæt hig gecwædon, þæt cyricgrið binnan wagum ⁊ cyninges handgrið stande efne unwemme.
Et hoc est primum edictum, ut ecclesie pax inter parietes suos et regis handgrið semper inuiolata (inconuulsa) permaneat.
⁊ þæt is þonon ærest, þæt hig gecwædon, þæt cyricgrið binnan wagum ⁊ cyninges handgrið stande efne unwemme.
Next after this, they declared that sanctuary within the walls of a church, and the protection granted by the king in person, shall remain equally inviolate.
Und nämlich zuerst nun, dass sie bestimmten, dass Kirchenfrieden innerhalb der Mauern und des Königs Handfriede gleich unverletzlich bestehe.
And namely first, that they determined that church-peace within the walls and the king’s hand-given peace should stand equally inviolable.
